footer.desc: Laboratory and diagnostic center in Tashkent. Advanced pathology, clinical diagnostics, and home sample collection.
footer.helpDesc: Submit a request, and our specialists will help you choose the right test.

hero.title: A laboratory where precision guides decisions
hero.desc: IPSUM Pathology combines pathomorphology, clinical diagnostic testing, and modern service to make the journey from booking to results seamless, fast, and reliable.

pathomorphology.title: Pathomorphology Laboratory
pathomorphology.text: Full cycle of morphological diagnostics: histology, cytology, intraoperative express diagnostics, immunohistochemistry, molecular diagnostics, digital pathology.

clinical.title: Clinical Diagnostic Laboratory
clinical.text: Comprehensive modern laboratory tests: general clinical, biochemical, hematological, coagulological, immunological, bacteriological, hormonal, molecular genetic tests, tumor markers, and more.

ngs.title: NGS
ngs.text: Full cycle of next-generation sequencing: targeted and whole-genome panels, exome and transcriptome sequencing, liquid biopsy, bioinformatic analysis, variant interpretation, and clinical reporting.

pcr.title: RT-PCR
pcr.text: Full cycle of real-time PCR diagnostics: quantitative and qualitative detection of mutations and translocations, gene expression analysis, minimal residual disease monitoring, infection/virus diagnostics, and quality control.

cytogenetics.title: Cytogenetics and FISH
cytogenetics.text: Full cycle of cytogenetic diagnostics: classic karyotyping, FISH on native and paraffin-embedded samples, detection of chromosome translocations, deletions, and amplifications, and diagnostics of hematologic/solid tumors.

cytometry.title: Flow Cytometry
cytometry.text: Full cycle of flow cytometry: immunophenotyping of hematological malignancies, minimal residual disease assessment, cell cycle and DNA ploidy analysis, leukemia and lymphoma diagnostics, and multi-color panel testing.

trust.title: Accuracy, speed, and trust
trust.text: IPSUM Pathology integrates laboratory diagnostics, pathology, and advanced molecular methods to deliver results that are actionable for physicians and clear for patients.
trust.f1_text: Clinical, pathological, and molecular studies unified in one single system.
trust.f2_text: Laboratory environment engineered for consistent and reproducible results.
trust.f3_text: Strict attention to detail at every step: from specimen collection to final report delivery.
trust.f4_text: Clear booking, friendly administrative consultation, and quick access to test results.

process.title: Testing made simple
process.subtitle: From request to results — a clear, hassle-free path.
process.s1_text: Choose a test or leave your contacts; our operator will clarify the details and convenient timing.
process.s2_text: Visit our branch or schedule a specialist visit to your preferred address.
process.s3_text: Your results are available online, in our Telegram bot, or directly at the branch.

partners.title: International expertise for accurate diagnostics
partners.desc: IPSUM Pathology collaborates with world-leading medical institutions, biotechnology firms, and laboratory diagnostics leaders. This ensures we implement advanced methods, maintain high diagnostic quality, and adopt best global practices.

cleveland.name: Cleveland Clinic
cleveland.text: One of the world's leading medical centers. Partnership provides access to cutting-edge diagnostic protocols and international medical practice standards.

roche.name: Hoffmann-La Roche
roche.text: Global leader in diagnostics and pharmaceuticals. Collaborative work helps develop immunohistochemical research and implement international quality standards.

centogene.name: CENTOGENE
centogene.text: Expert in genetic diagnostics of rare diseases. Partnership strengthens our capabilities in molecular genetic analysis and rare pathologies.

core.name: Core Diagnostics
core.text: Next-generation clinical laboratory. Knowledge exchange facilitates the implementation of modern diagnostic solutions and best Asian clinical practices.

foundation.name: Foundation Medicine
foundation.text: Leader in molecular oncology diagnostics. Collaboration enables comprehensive genomic profiling for personalized cancer therapies.

onecell.name: OneCell
onecell.text: Innovative single-cell analysis and liquid biopsy company, expanding opportunities for early cancer detection and monitoring.

memorial.name: Memorial
memorial.text: Leading network of medical centers in Turkey. Joint expertise in international-standard oncological diagnostics and treatment.

gallery.title: High-tech environment for precise laboratory diagnostics
gallery.desc: Modern diagnostics requires meticulous handling of biological samples, rigorous quality control, and clear communication with patients.

about.title: IPSUM PATHOLOGY
about.text: We combine laboratory precision, technological infrastructure, and clear communication with patients.

mission.title: Precision that guides medical decisions
mission.text: IPSUM Pathology was created for patients and physicians who demand reliable laboratory data, calm service, and fast access to results. We make the entire pathway clear and convenient.

corporate.s1_title: Patients experience a clear pathway from first contact
corporate.s1_text: We focus not only on testing, but also on communication: our administrators assist with scheduling, test prep, and convenient report delivery.
corporate.s2_text: Testing takes place in a state-of-the-art laboratory environment where order, rigor, and attentive specialist work are paramount.

values.title: The pillars of our trust
values.v1_text: We operate laboratory workflows where control, reproducibility, and attention to detail are critical.
values.v2_text: Patients receive a straightforward pathway: appointment, sample collection, and convenient results delivery.
values.v3_text: We leverage a cutting-edge laboratory environment for clinical, molecular, and pathological testing.

route.title: From appointment to results without unnecessary complexity
route.desc: We build our service around a patient-first experience: minimal uncertainty, responsive communication, and transparent testing stages.
route.step1_text: Administrators help select the right direction, collection format, and convenient time.
route.step2_text: Biomaterials undergo preparation and examination in a strictly controlled environment.
route.step3_text: Reports are delivered online or at the branch so doctors and patients can act quickly.

licenses.title: Licenses and Certificates
licenses.desc: IPSUM Pathology is fully licensed. We regularly undergo external quality control evaluations to verify testing accuracy.
licenses.l1_desc: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Uzbekistan license for medical activity
licenses.l2_desc: Certificate of state registration of a legal entity
licenses.l3_desc: Certificate of conformity with ISO quality management standards

education.title: Clinical Residency Program
education.text: Clinical residency program in 'Pathological Anatomy' for the 2026/2027 academic year.

intro.title: Training specialists for precision laboratory diagnostics
intro.desc: The program is designed for physicians who want to master modern laboratory methods, clinical data interpretation, and advanced hands-on pathomorphology diagnostic skills.

features.f1: Hands-on training under the guidance of experienced pathomorphologists
features.f2: Immunohistochemistry, molecular diagnostics, and digital pathology
features.f3: Interdisciplinary teamwork with clinicians across multiple specialties

gallery.title: Modern clinical and laboratory base
gallery.desc: Residents participate in real clinical cases, mastering next-generation histology, IHC, and molecular diagnostic equipment.

international.title: International Cooperation
international.desc: Our laboratory collaborates with leading medical institutions and research centers in the USA, Turkey, and India in pathology, histology, and molecular diagnostics, offering residents world-class clinical knowledge.

diploma.title: Diploma & Employment
diploma.desc: Upon completion of the residency, a state-recognized diploma is issued. Graduates gain employment opportunities in leading national laboratories and international diagnostic centers.
